opening.argument: The video presents playing Ludo as a route to unlimited daily Paytm cash and says viewers can earn ₹625 in a Paytm wallet. It pairs that earning pitch with paid participation: the speaker says a player can pay ₹10 and get ₹18. The app also displays entry and win amounts alongside wallet controls to Add Money and Withdraw. Signup calls for account and personal details, while the description directs viewers to a Telegram Paytm giveaway. Together, these are concrete inducements to put money and information into a promised reward opportunity. The records do not establish that payments or rewards occurred, that data was misused, or that the external giveaway took place.
